text:
sara: Heads-up — ACME (workspace ws_9Xk3) reporting lots of console graphs failing to render. Panels spin then the UI reports a 503 from the analytics API. Happening in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 since ~10:12 UTC. Correlation ids below.

ops-bot: Alert: analytics-api 5xx spike at 2026-03-16T10:12:00Z — ~150 errors/min. Runbook: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/analytics-5xx (auto-note).

jess (CS): Sara — can you paste the workspace id + one sample correlation id + a minimal repro (panel query / time range)? Need to prod customer and provide workaround.

sara: Workspace: acme-corp-prod (ws_9Xk3). Correlation ids: cid=acme-7f2b, cid=acme-7f2c, cid=acme-7f30. Example panel query (simplified):
```sql
SELECT sum(request_count) as requests
FROM host.metrics
WHERE service = 'ingest'
  AND timestamp >= '2026-03-16T09:00:00Z'
  AND timestamp <= '2026-03-16T10:00:00Z'
GROUP BY 1m
```
Repro curl:
```bash
curl -s -D - -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/analytics/query \
  -d '{"workspace":"ws_9Xk3","start":"2026-03-16T09:00:00Z","end":"2026-03-16T10:00:00Z","query":"<query above>"}'
# Response: HTTP/1.1 503
# {"error":"upstream timeout","code":"ANALYTICS_503","correlation_id":"acme-7f2b"}
```

matt: Thanks Sara. I'm seeing a matching spike in slow shard responses around that time. Yesterday's KV cache eviction job (rollout v2) caused higher cold-miss rates for a subset of hot prefixes; some queries fall back to full-fetch and produce long tail latency -> 503s from the fetcher. Correlation ids map to shard 7 and proxy pod analytics-proxy-7.

liam: Quick repro note: narrow the time window to 5m and the same query returns fine. Also adding a sample_rate=0.1 param reduces workload and returns without 503. So it's likely workload amplification + cold KV misses.

matt: Immediate steps I'm taking:
- adding per-shard extra retry (2x) in proxy for short 5s window.
- temp rollback of the KV-evict flag in staging to validate (if rollback fixes staging, we'll plan a quick rollback in prod).
- opening INC ticket INC-2026-42 and paging oncall.

jess (CS): Customer-facing mitigation suggestions we can give ACME now: 1) change dashboard panels to use aggregated metric (sum over 15m) instead of 1m, 2) increase panel timeout from 10s to 30s, or 3) switch query to sample_rate=0.1 until we patch. Which is fastest to recommend?

sara: I'll share 2) and 3) — easiest for them. Also sending their customer success engineer a quick howto for panel timeout and sample_rate.

devex-bot: Note: there's a known issue link for KV cold miss + analytics fanout: https://internal/redwood/notes/kv-cold-miss-fanout — tagging for visibility.

matt: For engineering fix: plan is to revert the eviction threshold change for now (low risk) and add a gradual warm-up rollout plus better backpressure (queue limit per shard). If rollback shows improvement, we'll schedule a constrained rollout with monitoring.

jess (CS): I'll message the ACME SRE with the workaround & ETA. Sara — please paste the customer-facing snippet for timeout change (UI steps) and I'll send it.

sara: Paste for them: Settings > Edit Panel > Advanced > "Request timeout" set to 30s. And in their custom query params add `sample_rate=0.1`.

matt: Created INC-2026-42 and added logs + sample correlation ids. Will update thread when rollback is validated.

jess (CS): Thanks — marking this high priority for CS follow-up. :thumbsup:
